title.en: An Act Creating Two (2) Additional Municipal Trial Court Branches in the City of Roxas, Province of Capiz, Amending for that Purpose Section 29 of Batas Pambansa Blg. 129, as amended, otherwise known as the Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980

text.en: The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court in coordination with the Secretary of the Department of Justice shall immediately include in the Court's program the operationalization of two (2) additional municipal trial court branches for the City of Roxas, Province of Capiz, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
